_comment: Cloudflare bill snapshot, transcribed from the dashboard's Billing >
Usage page on 2026-09-03 (Issue 065 / Bench 067). This exists so the
generated reconciliation can be cross-checked against the real bill
instead of against itself -- a cost model that only agrees with its own
arithmetic is what shipped here for a week.
`billable` and `usd` are Cloudflare's OWN numbers, not derived: they are
what pins the two non-obvious rules (allowance subtraction, and KV's
round-up-to-the-next-million). Do NOT recompute these fields.
_precision: Cloudflare prints `used` at 3 significant figures and `billable` exactly,
so where the two disagree the exact one wins and `used` is reconstructed
as billable + included (`used_reconstructed: true`). KV list is the only
such line here: the page reads `1.3M` used / `301.97k` billable, and
1.3M - 1M = 300k != 301.97k. Transcribing the DISPLAYED used would put a
1,970-op error into the one line whose block-rounding is 30% of a block.
notes: Container egress 17.66 GB equals app a03a70ff's egress EXACTLY, so that
one app is 100% of the account's container egress, 95.2% of its memory
and 95.1% of its disk. The app is NOT missing from Cloudflare -- its
COST is, because 246.33k GB-s of disk is 34% of the 720k GB-s (200
GB-hour) monthly allowance, so the disk line is billable 0.
